description: tcp-json/json: JSON records, timestamp from time/timestamp/@timestamp

script.source: for (String f : ['time', 'timestamp', '@timestamp']) { def v = ctx.get(f); String s = null; if (v instanceof String) { s = ((String) v).trim(); } else if (v instanceof Number) { s = String.valueOf(((Number) v).longValue()); } if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) { continue; } boolean digits = true; for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) { if (!Character.isDigit(s.charAt(i))) { digits = false; break; } } if (digits && s.length() == 10) { s = Instant.ofEpochSecond(Long.parseLong(s)).toString(); } else if (digits && s.length() == 13) { s = Instant.ofEpochMilli(Long.parseLong(s)).toString(); } ctx._ts = s; ctx._ts_field = f; break; }

formats: EEE, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss Z
